````python
import getpass
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.core.validators import validate_email
from django.contrib.auth.password_validation import validate_password
from django.db import transaction
from apps.accounts.models import User, Role
from apps.core.models import AuditEvent

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help='Create an administrator interactively after running seed.'
    @transaction.atomic
    def handle(self,*args,**options):
        if not Role.objects.filter(pk=1).exists():raise CommandError('Run seed first.')
        email=input('Administrator email: ').strip().lower();validate_email(email)
        if User.objects.filter(email__iexact=email).exists():raise CommandError('An account already exists for this email.')
        first=input('First name: ').strip();last=input('Last name: ').strip()
        password=getpass.getpass('Password: ');confirm=getpass.getpass('Confirm password: ')
        if password!=confirm:raise CommandError('Passwords do not match.')
        validate_password(password)
        user=User(username=email,email=email,first_name=first,last_name=last,role_id=1,is_staff=True)
        user.set_password(password);user.save()
        AuditEvent.objects.create(actor=user,entity='accounts.user',entity_id=str(user.pk),action='administrator_created')
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS('Administrator created.'))
````

## backend/apps/core/management/commands/document_expiry_alerts.py

````python
from datetime import timedelta
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.accounts.models import User
from apps.employees.models import EmployeeDocument
from apps.core.models import AuditEvent
from apps.core.mail import notify
class Command(BaseCommand):
    help='Send HR document-expiry alerts at 60, 30 and 7 days, once per document/threshold/date.'
    def handle(self,*args,**options):
        today=timezone.localdate();count=0
        recipients=list(User.objects.filter(role_id=1,is_active=True,is_deleted=False).values_list('email',flat=True))
        for days in [60,30,7]:
            for row in EmployeeDocument.objects.filter(expiry_date=today+timedelta(days=days),is_archived=False):
                marker=f'expiry_{days}_{today.isoformat()}'
                if AuditEvent.objects.filter(entity='employees.employeedocument',entity_id=str(row.pk),action=marker).exists():continue
                delivered=[notify(email,'HRDESK document expiry',f'Document {row.pk} expires in {days} days. Sign in to review.') for email in recipients]
                if delivered and all(item.delivery_status=='Sent' for item in delivered):
                    AuditEvent.objects.create(entity='employees.employeedocument',entity_id=str(row.pk),action=marker)
                    count+=1
        self.stdout.write(f'Sent alerts for {count} documents.')
````

````python
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from apps.core.models import EmailDelivery
from apps.core.mail import deliver
class Command(BaseCommand):
    help='Retry failed email deliveries with fewer than three attempts.'
    def handle(self,*args,**options):
        count=0
        for row in EmailDelivery.objects.filter(delivery_status='Failed',attempts__lt=3):
            deliver(row);count+=1
        self.stdout.write(f'Processed {count} failed email deliveries.')
````

## backend/apps/core/management/commands/seed.py

````python
import json
from pathlib import Path
from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils.text import slugify
from apps.accounts.models import Role, MenuItem, RolePermission
from apps.masters.models import MasterItem, WorkWeek
from apps.core.models import Company, Theme, Localisation
from apps.core.registry import RESOURCES, MASTERS

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help='Seed authoritative role grants and reference master lists idempotently.'
    def add_arguments(self,parser):parser.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    @transaction.atomic
    def handle(self,*args,**options):
        root=Path(settings.BASE_DIR).parent/'specification'/'schemas'
        permission=json.loads((root/'permissions.json').read_text())
        seed=json.loads((root/'seed-data.json').read_text())
        ids=[x['menu_id'] for x in permission['menu_items']]
        if len(ids)!=75 or len(set(ids))!=75:raise CommandError('Expected 75 unique menu permissions.')
        if options['check']:
            self.stdout.write('Validated 75 unique menu permissions.');return
        menu_routes={1:'/',46:'/leave/manager',71:'/me/profile',29:'/employees',28:'/attendance/admin',31:'/leave/admin',81:'/employees/hiring-process',75:'/employees/hierarchy',16:'/holidays',55:'/leave',56:'/leave/balance',27:'/attendance',30:'/policies',58:'/directory',65:'/projects',66:'/tasks',77:'/pmo/newsletters',78:'/pmo/wsr',79:'/pmo/queries',80:'/pmo/whos-where',82:'/timesheets',42:'/reports/leave',68:'/reports/attendance',85:'/reports/pmo',40:'/settings/company',36:'/settings/email',34:'/settings/theme',35:'/settings/localisation',52:'/wfh',45:'/rms/roles',47:'/rms/applicants',69:'/rms/documents',86:'/rms/pipeline',57:'/masters/leave-years',84:'/masters/holiday-years',83:'/ho-documents',54:'/masters/technical-questions',53:'/masters/interview-questions',15:'/masters/work-week'}
        for slug,(code,title) in MASTERS.items():menu_routes.setdefault(code,'/masters/'+slug)
        for index,item in enumerate(permission['menu_items']):
            row=MenuItem.all_objects.filter(pk=item['menu_id']).first() or MenuItem(pk=item['menu_id'])
            row.title=item['label'];row.slug=slugify(item['label']);row.route=menu_routes.get(row.pk,'')
            row.order=index;row.is_menu=row.pk not in [9,37,38,59];row.master_status=True
            row.save()
        for item in permission['menu_items']:
            row=MenuItem.objects.get(pk=item['menu_id']);row.parent_id=item['parent_id'];row.save()
        for code,source in permission['roles'].items():
            role=Role.all_objects.filter(pk=int(code)).first() or Role(pk=int(code))
            role.title=source['name'];role.slug=slugify(source['name']);role.save()
            # Initial seed never overwrites administrator-edited grants on subsequent runs.
            if not RolePermission.all_objects.filter(role=role).exists():
                for menu_id in source['permissions']:RolePermission(role=role,menu_item_id=menu_id).save()
        mapping={'education_levels':'education-levels','employment_statuses':'employment-statuses','working_modes':'working-modes','document_types':'document-types','document_list':'document-list','sub_units':'sub-units','job_titles':'job-titles','termination_reasons':'termination-reasons','work_authorizations':'work-authorizations','currency_codes':'currency-codes','technical_statuses':'technical-statuses','interview_statuses':'interview-statuses','evaluation_statuses':'evaluation-statuses'}
        for key,source in seed['lists'].items():
            kind=mapping.get(key,key.replace('_','-'))
            if kind not in MASTERS:continue
            for source_row in source.get('rows',[]):
                name=source_row.get('Name',source_row.get('Title',source_row.get('Country','')))
                if not name:continue
                if not MasterItem.all_objects.filter(kind=kind,name__iexact=name).exists():
                    MasterItem(kind=kind,name=name,status=source_row.get('Status','Active')=='Active',description=source_row.get('Description',''),time_zone=source_row.get('TimeZone','Europe/London')).save()
        process=MasterItem.objects.filter(kind='processes',name='UK').first()
        if process and not WorkWeek.objects.filter(process=process).exists():WorkWeek(process=process).save()
        for model in [Company,Theme,Localisation]:
            if not model.objects.exists():model().save()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS('Seeded roles, 75 menu permissions and captured reference lists.'))
````

## backend/apps/core/middleware.py

````python
import logging
import uuid
from django.conf import settings

logger = logging.getLogger("hrdesk")


class RequestMetadataMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
        request.request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        response = self.get_response(request)
        response["X-Request-ID"] = request.request_id
        if settings.ENVIRONMENT == "production":
            response["Content-Security-Policy"] = (
                "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; "
                "img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'"
            )
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            # Route templates avoid leaking personal values in URL parameters.
            route = getattr(getattr(request, "resolver_match", None), "route", "unmatched")
            user_id = getattr(getattr(request, "user", None), "pk", None)
            logger.warning("HTTP %s request_id=%s user_id=%s route=%s",
                           response.status_code, request.request_id, user_id, route)
        return response
````

````python
from django.conf import settings
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models, transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone


class AuditQuerySet(models.QuerySet):
    def update(self, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError("Audit events are append-only.")

    def delete(self):
        raise ValidationError("Audit events are append-only.")

    def bulk_update(self, objs, fields, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError("Audit events are append-only.")


class AuditEvent(models.Model):
    actor = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    entity = models.CharField(max_length=120)
    entity_id = models.CharField(max_length=64)
    action = models.CharField(max_length=40)
    before = models.JSONField(default=dict)
    after = models.JSONField(default=dict)
    at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now, editable=False, db_index=True)
    objects = AuditQuerySet.as_manager()

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-at", "-pk"]
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=["entity", "entity_id"], name="audit_entity_idx")]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self._state.adding:
            raise ValidationError("Audit events are append-only.")
        return super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def delete(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError("Audit events are append-only.")


class BusinessQuerySet(models.QuerySet):
    def delete(self):
        raise ValidationError("Use instance.delete(actor=...) for audited soft deletion.")

    def update(self, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError("Use instance.save(actor=...) for audited changes.")

    def bulk_create(self, objs, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError("Bulk writes bypass auditing and are disabled.")

    def bulk_update(self, objs, fields, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError("Bulk writes bypass auditing and are disabled.")


class ActiveManager(models.Manager.from_queryset(BusinessQuerySet)):
    def get_queryset(self):
        return super().get_queryset().filter(is_deleted=False)


class BaseModel(models.Model):
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    status = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    is_deleted = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    deleted_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    objects = ActiveManager()
    all_objects = BusinessQuerySet.as_manager()
    # Subclasses explicitly opt non-sensitive fields into audit snapshots.
    audit_fields = ("status", "is_deleted")

    class Meta:
        abstract = True
        base_manager_name = "all_objects"
        default_manager_name = "objects"
        constraints = [models.CheckConstraint(
            condition=Q(is_deleted=False, deleted_at__isnull=True) | Q(is_deleted=True, deleted_at__isnull=False),
            name="%(app_label)s_%(class)s_deletion_consistent",
        )]

    def audit_snapshot(self):
        import json
        from django.core.serializers.json import DjangoJSONEncoder
        excluded = {"password", "answers", "medical_condition", "driver_licence_number", "address", "bank_details", "number", "digest"}
        values = {field.attname: getattr(self, field.attname) for field in self._meta.fields
                  if field.name not in excluded and not isinstance(field, EncryptedTextField)}
        return json.loads(json.dumps(values, cls=DjangoJSONEncoder))

    def save(self, *args, actor=None, **kwargs):
        with transaction.atomic():
            prior = None if self._state.adding else type(self).all_objects.select_for_update().get(pk=self.pk)
            before = prior.audit_snapshot() if prior else {}
            super().save(*args, **kwargs)
            self.refresh_from_db()
            AuditEvent.objects.create(actor=actor, entity=self._meta.label_lower, entity_id=str(self.pk),
                                      action="create" if prior is None else "update",
                                      before=before, after=self.audit_snapshot())

    def delete(self, using=None, keep_parents=False, *, actor=None):
        with transaction.atomic():
            current = type(self).all_objects.select_for_update().get(pk=self.pk)
            if current.is_deleted:
                return (0, {})
            before = current.audit_snapshot()
            current.is_deleted = True
            current.deleted_at = timezone.now()
            models.Model.save(current, update_fields=["is_deleted", "deleted_at", "updated_at"])
            AuditEvent.objects.create(actor=actor, entity=self._meta.label_lower, entity_id=str(self.pk),
                                      action="delete", before=before, after=current.audit_snapshot())
            self.is_deleted, self.deleted_at = current.is_deleted, current.deleted_at
            return (1, {self._meta.label: 1})
````

````python
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .api import ResourceViewSet

class NestedResource(ResourceViewSet):
    parent_model=None
    parent_field=''
    def get_queryset(self):
        qs=super().get_queryset()
        get_object_or_404(self.parent_model.objects,pk=self.kwargs['parent_id'])
        return qs.filter(**{self.parent_field+'_id':self.kwargs['parent_id']})
    def get_serializer(self,*args,**kwargs):
        if 'data' in kwargs:
            data=kwargs['data'].copy();data[self.parent_field]=self.kwargs['parent_id'];kwargs['data']=data
        return super().get_serializer(*args,**kwargs)
````

## backend/apps/core/services.py

````python
import calendar
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Sum
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError, APIException, PermissionDenied
from apps.core.access import is_hr, require_menu, reporting_manager

class Conflict(APIException):
    status_code = 409
    default_detail = "This conflicts with an existing record."


def employee_for(user):
    from apps.employees.models import Employee
    try:
        return Employee.objects.get(user=user)
    except Employee.DoesNotExist:
        raise ValidationError({"user": ["An employee profile is required."]})


def work_capacity(employee, date):
    from apps.masters.models import WorkWeek
    from apps.holidays.models import Holiday
    week = WorkWeek.objects.filter(process=employee.process).first()
    if week:
        kind = getattr(week, ['mon','tue','wed','thu','fri','sat','sun'][date.weekday()])
        capacity = {'Full Day':Decimal('1'),'Half Day':Decimal('.5'),'Non-Working Day':Decimal('0')}[kind]
    else:
        capacity = Decimal('1') if date.weekday() in employee.working_days else Decimal('0')
    holidays = Holiday.objects.filter(date=date, status=True)
    if employee.process_id:
        holidays = holidays.filter(process_id=employee.process_id)
    for holiday in holidays:
        capacity = max(Decimal('0'), capacity - (Decimal('1') if holiday.type == 'Full Day' else Decimal('.5')))
    return capacity


def leave_usage(user, leave_type, exclude=None):
    from apps.leave.models import LeaveRequest, LeaveEntitlement
    entitlement = LeaveEntitlement.objects.filter(user=user, leave_type=leave_type).first()
    assigned = entitlement.assigned if entitlement else Decimal('0')
    rows = LeaveRequest.objects.filter(user=user, leave_type=leave_type)
    if exclude:
        rows = rows.exclude(pk=exclude)
    used = rows.filter(status='Approve With Pay').aggregate(n=Sum('days'))['n'] or Decimal('0')
    pending = rows.filter(status='Pending').aggregate(n=Sum('days'))['n'] or Decimal('0')
    return {'assigned': assigned, 'used': used, 'pending': pending, 'balance': assigned-used, 'available':assigned-used-pending}


def allocate_entitlements(leave_type, actor=None):
    from apps.employees.models import Employee
    from apps.leave.models import LeaveEntitlement
    year = leave_type.leave_year
    count = 0
    for employee in Employee.objects.filter(status=True, process_id=year.process_id, date_of_joining__lte=year.to_date):
        start = max(year.from_date, employee.date_of_joining)
        end = min(year.to_date, employee.deactivated_on or year.to_date)
        days = max(0,(end-start).days+1)
        assigned = (leave_type.allocation_per_year * Decimal(days) / Decimal((year.to_date-year.from_date).days+1)
                    * Decimal(employee.working_capacity_pct) / Decimal(100)).quantize(Decimal('.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        if not LeaveEntitlement.objects.filter(user=employee.user,leave_type=leave_type).exists():
            item=LeaveEntitlement(user=employee.user,leave_type=leave_type,assigned=assigned)
            item.save(actor=actor)
            count += 1
    return count


def validate_leave(data, user, instance=None):
    from apps.leave.models import LeaveRequest
    employee = employee_for(user)
    lt = data['leave_type']
    start, end = data['from_date'], data['to_date']
    if not lt.status or not lt.leave_year.status:
        raise ValidationError({'leave_type':['Please select an active leave type.']})
    if lt.process_id != employee.process_id:
        raise ValidationError({'leave_type':['Leave type must belong to the employee process.']})
    if start>end or start<lt.leave_year.from_date or end>lt.leave_year.to_date:
        raise ValidationError({'to_date':['Dates must be ordered and within the leave year.']})
    duration=data.get('duration','Full Day')
    if duration!='Full Day' and start!=end:
        raise ValidationError({'duration':['Half-day leave must cover one date.']})
    rows=LeaveRequest.objects.filter(user=user,from_date__lte=end,to_date__gte=start).exclude(status='Rejected')
    if instance: rows=rows.exclude(pk=instance.pk)
    if rows.exists(): raise Conflict('An active leave request overlaps these dates.')
    days=Decimal('0')
    day=start
    while day<=end:
        days+=min(work_capacity(employee,day),Decimal('1') if duration=='Full Day' else Decimal('.5'))
        day+=timedelta(days=1)
    if days<=0: raise ValidationError({'from_date':['Select at least one working day.']})
    usage=leave_usage(user,lt,instance.pk if instance else None)
    if days>usage['available']:
        balance=format(usage['available'].normalize(),'f')
        raise ValidationError({'non_field_errors':[f'You only left {balance} balance leaves , and you cannot apply more than that balance leave, please contact admin.']})
    data['days']=days
    return data


def decide(instance, action, actor, reason=''):
    from apps.leave.models import LeaveRequest
    from apps.timesheets.models import Timesheet, TimesheetLog
    from apps.wfh.models import WfhRequest
    from apps.pmo.models import WeeklyStatusReport, Query
    with transaction.atomic():
        row=type(instance).objects.select_for_update().get(pk=instance.pk)
        if isinstance(row,LeaveRequest):
            if row.status!='Pending': raise Conflict('This leave request has already been decided.')
            if action=='reject' and not reason.strip(): raise ValidationError({'reason':['Please enter some reason for rejection']})
            if not is_hr(actor):
                require_menu(actor,46)
                if not reporting_manager(actor) or employee_for(row.user).reports_to_id != actor.pk or row.user_id==actor.pk:
                    raise PermissionDenied()
                row.manager_status='Rejected' if action=='reject' else 'Approved'
                row.rejection_reason=reason if action=='reject' else ''
            else:
                require_menu(actor,31)
                if action=='approve':
                    if row.days>leave_usage(row.user,row.leave_type,row.pk)['available']:
                        raise ValidationError({'non_field_errors':['Insufficient leave balance.']})
                    row.status='Approve With Pay'
                elif action=='approve-unpaid':row.status='Approve Without Pay'
                else:row.status='Rejected'
                row.rejection_reason=reason if action=='reject' else ''
        elif isinstance(row,WfhRequest):
            require_menu(actor,52)
            if not is_hr(actor):raise PermissionDenied()
            if row.status!='Pending':raise Conflict('This request has already been decided.')
            if action=='reject' and not reason.strip():raise ValidationError({'reason':['Please enter some reason for rejection']})
            row.status='Rejected' if action=='reject' else 'Approved'
            row.rejection_reason=reason if action=='reject' else ''
        elif isinstance(row,Timesheet):
            require_menu(actor,82)
            if not is_hr(actor):raise PermissionDenied()
            if row.approval_status!='Pending':raise Conflict('This timesheet has already been decided.')
            if action=='reject' and not reason.strip():raise ValidationError({'reason':['Please enter a rejection comment.']})
            row.approval_status='Rejected' if action=='reject' else 'Accepted'
            log=TimesheetLog(timesheet=row,action=row.approval_status,comment=reason,actor=actor)
            log.save(actor=actor)
        elif isinstance(row,WeeklyStatusReport):
            require_menu(actor,78)
            if not is_hr(actor):raise PermissionDenied()
            if row.status!='Submitted':raise Conflict('This report has already been decided.')
            row.status='Rejected' if action=='reject' else 'Approved'
        elif isinstance(row,Query):
            require_menu(actor,79)
            if not is_hr(actor) or action!='close':raise PermissionDenied()
            if row.status=='Closed':raise Conflict('This query is already closed.')
            row.status='Closed'
        else:raise ValidationError({'action':['Unsupported action.']})
        row.save(actor=actor)
        from .mail import request_notification
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: request_notification(row,decision=True))
        return row
````

## backend/apps/core/settings_api.py

````python
from django.apps import apps
from django.db import transaction
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .access import require_menu, require_super
from .api import model_serializer

class SettingsView(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    sections={'company':('Company',40),'theme':('Theme',34),'localisation':('Localisation',35),'email':('SmtpProfile',36)}
    def context(self,request,section):
        if section not in self.sections:raise ValidationError({'section':['Unknown settings section.']})
        name,menu=self.sections[section];require_menu(request.user,menu);require_super(request.user)
        return apps.get_model('core',name)
    def get(self,request,section):
        model=self.context(request,section)
        if section=='email':
            rows=model_serializer(model,request.user)(model.objects.all(),many=True).data
            for row in rows:row.pop('password',None)
            return Response(rows)
        row=model.objects.first()
        return Response(model_serializer(model,request.user)(row).data if row else {})
    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self,request,section):
        model=self.context(request,section)
        row=model.objects.filter(profile=request.data.get('profile')).first() if section=='email' else model.objects.first()
        serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)(row,data=request.data,partial=True)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        row=row or model()
        for key,value in serializer.validated_data.items():setattr(row,key,value)
        if section=='theme':
            import re
            for key in ['primary_color','secondary_color','sidebar_color']:
                if not re.fullmatch(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}',getattr(row,key)):raise ValidationError({key:['Enter a six-digit hexadecimal colour.']})
        if section in ['company','localisation']:
            from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo, ZoneInfoNotFoundError
            try:ZoneInfo(row.time_zone if section=='company' else row.timezone)
            except ZoneInfoNotFoundError:raise ValidationError({'timezone':['Choose a valid IANA timezone.']})
        row.full_clean(validate_unique=False,validate_constraints=False)
        row.save(actor=request.user)
        data=model_serializer(model,request.user)(row).data
        data.pop('password',None)
        return Response(data)
````

## backend/apps/core/ui.py

````python
from django.apps import apps
from django.db import models
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from .registry import RESOURCES, MASTERS
from .access import has_menu, is_hr
from .api import model_serializer, MESSAGES
from .fields import EncryptedTextField

PATHS={'leave/requests':'/leave','leave/entitlements':'/leave/entitlements','wfh-requests':'/wfh','holiday-years':'/masters/holiday-years','leave-years':'/masters/leave-years','leave-types':'/masters/leave-types','holidays':'/holidays','newsletters':'/pmo/newsletters','wsr':'/pmo/wsr','queries':'/pmo/queries','whos-where':'/pmo/whos-where','hierarchy-documents':'/employees/hierarchy','hiring-documents':'/employees/hiring-process','attendance/records':'/attendance/admin'}

class ResourceMetadata(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request):
        output=[]
        for key,spec in RESOURCES.items():
            if not has_menu(request.user,spec.menu) and not (spec.scope=='leave' and has_menu(request.user,31)):continue
            if key=='employees' and not is_hr(request.user):continue
            model=apps.get_model(spec.model)
            serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)()
            fields=[]
            for name,sfield in serializer.fields.items():
                if name in ['created_at','updated_at']:continue
                field=model._meta.get_field(name)
                typ='text';relation=None
                if isinstance(field,models.BooleanField):typ='boolean'
                elif isinstance(field,models.DateTimeField):typ='datetime-local'
                elif isinstance(field,models.DateField):typ='date'
                elif isinstance(field,(models.IntegerField,models.DecimalField)):typ='number'
                elif isinstance(field,models.JSONField):typ='json'
                elif isinstance(field,models.TextField):typ='richtext' if name in ['message','description','notes'] else 'textarea'
                if field.is_relation:
                    typ='file' if field.related_model._meta.label=='core.PrivateFile' else 'select'
                    relation=field.related_model._meta.label
                choices=list(getattr(field,'choices',[]) or [])
                if choices:typ='choice'
                fields.append({'name':name,'label':name.replace('_',' ').capitalize(),'type':typ,'required':sfield.required,
                    'read_only':sfield.read_only,'multiple':field.many_to_many,'relation':relation,'choices':choices,
                    'message':MESSAGES.get(model.__name__,{}).get(name),'default':field.get_default() if field.has_default() else None,
                    'sensitive':isinstance(field,EncryptedTextField)})
            if model.__name__=='MasterItem':
                slug=key.split('/')[-1]
                extra={'working-modes':['description'],'processes':['time_zone'],'document-list':['parent'],'locations':['parent'],'job-titles':['description','file'],'clients':['email','contact_no','description'],'customers':['description'],'reporting-managers':['parent','extra'],'letters':['description']}.get(slug,[])
                fields=[f for f in fields if f['name'] in ['id','name','status']+extra]
            writable=spec.scope!='readonly' and (spec.scope not in ['projects','read_all'] or is_hr(request.user))
            actions=[]
            if is_hr(request.user):
                if model.__name__ in ['LeaveRequest','WfhRequest','WeeklyStatusReport']:actions=['approve','reject']
                if model.__name__=='LeaveRequest':actions+=['approve-unpaid']
                if model.__name__=='Timesheet':actions=['accept','reject']
                if model.__name__=='Query':actions=['close']
                if any(f.name=='is_archived' for f in model._meta.fields):actions+=['archive']
            output.append({'key':key,'title':spec.title,'path':PATHS.get(key,'/'+key),'fields':fields,'writable':writable,'actions':actions})
        return Response(output)

class LookupView(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request,kind):
        from apps.masters.models import MasterItem
        from apps.accounts.models import User
        if kind in ['users','accounts.User']:
            return Response([{'id':u.pk,'name':u.get_full_name() or u.username} for u in User.objects.filter(is_active=True,is_deleted=False)])
        if kind in MASTERS:
            return Response(list(MasterItem.objects.filter(kind=kind,status=True).values('id','name')))
        if kind=='masters.MasterItem':
            return Response([{'id':m.pk,'name':f'{m.kind}: {m.name}'} for m in MasterItem.objects.filter(status=True)])
        if kind in ['leave.LeaveType','leave.LeaveYear'] and (has_menu(request.user,55) or has_menu(request.user,56) or has_menu(request.user,31)):
            from .services import employee_for
            model=apps.get_model(kind)
            rows=model.objects.filter(status=True)
            if not is_hr(request.user):rows=rows.filter(process=employee_for(request.user).process)
            if kind=='leave.LeaveType':rows=rows.filter(leave_year__status=True)
            return Response([{'id':r.pk,'name':r.name if hasattr(r,'name') else f'{r.from_date} – {r.to_date}'} for r in rows])
        if kind=='accounts.Role':
            from .access import require_super
            require_super(request.user)
            return Response([{'id':r.pk,'name':r.title} for r in apps.get_model('accounts.Role').objects.filter(status=True)])
        candidates=[(key,s) for key,s in RESOURCES.items() if s.model==kind]
        if not candidates:raise ValidationError({'kind':['Unknown lookup.']})
        for key,spec in candidates:
            if not has_menu(request.user,spec.menu):continue
            from .api import ResourceViewSet
            view=ResourceViewSet();view.request=request;view.resource_key=key
            rows=view.get_queryset()
            if hasattr(rows.model,'status') and isinstance(rows.model._meta.get_field('status'),models.BooleanField):rows=rows.filter(status=True)
            return Response([{'id':r.pk,'name':getattr(r,'name',None) or getattr(r,'title',None) or getattr(r,'employee_code',None) or f'{kind.split(".")[-1]} {r.pk}'} for r in rows])
        raise PermissionDenied()

class ProfileMetadata(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request,section):
        from .registry import PROFILE
        if section not in PROFILE:raise ValidationError({'section':['Unknown section.']})
        if not has_menu(request.user,29) and not has_menu(request.user,71):raise PermissionDenied()
        model=apps.get_model('employees',PROFILE[section])
        serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)()
        fields=[]
        for name,sfield in serializer.fields.items():
            if name in ['created_at','updated_at','user']:continue
            field=model._meta.get_field(name)
            typ='text';relation=None
            if isinstance(field,models.BooleanField):typ='boolean'
            elif isinstance(field,models.DateField):typ='date'
            elif isinstance(field,(models.IntegerField,models.DecimalField)):typ='number'
            elif isinstance(field,models.JSONField):typ='json'
            elif isinstance(field,models.TextField):typ='textarea'
            if field.is_relation:
                typ='file' if field.related_model._meta.label=='core.PrivateFile' else 'select';relation=field.related_model._meta.label
            choices=list(getattr(field,'choices',[]) or [])
            if choices:typ='choice'
            fields.append({'name':name,'label':name.replace('_',' ').capitalize(),'type':typ,'required':sfield.required,'read_only':sfield.read_only,'multiple':False,'relation':relation,'choices':choices,'default':field.get_default() if field.has_default() else None})
        return Response({'key':section,'title':section.replace('-',' '),'fields':fields})
````

````python
import re
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

PASSWORD_MESSAGE = "Password must be 12+ chars with upper, lower, number & special character."

class StrongPasswordValidator:
    def validate(self, password, user=None):
        if len(password) < 12 or not all(re.search(pattern, password) for pattern in [r"[A-Z]", r"[a-z]", r"[0-9]", r"[^A-Za-z0-9]"]):
            raise ValidationError(PASSWORD_MESSAGE)

    def get_help_text(self):
        return PASSWORD_MESSAGE
````

````python
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.middleware.csrf import get_token
from django.views.decorators.cache import never_cache
from rest_framework.permissions import AllowAny
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import APIView


class HealthView(APIView):
    authentication_classes = []
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response({"status": "ok"})


@never_cache
def csrf_token(request):
    if request.method != "GET":
        response = JsonResponse({"message": "Method not allowed.", "errors": {}}, status=405)
        response["Allow"] = "GET"
        return response
    # CSRF value is not an authentication token; session cookie stays HttpOnly.
    return JsonResponse({"csrfToken": get_token(request)})


class SpaView(APIView):
    authentication_classes = []
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    def get(self, request, path=""):
        from django.conf import settings
        from django.http import FileResponse
        index = settings.BASE_DIR.parent / "frontend" / "build" / "index.html"
        if not index.is_file():
            return Response({"message":"Build the frontend with npm run build before serving this URL.","errors":{}}, status=503)
        response = FileResponse(index.open("rb"), content_type="text/html")
        response["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
        return response
````

````python
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from apps.core.access import require_menu, require_hr, is_hr
from apps.core.api import model_serializer
from apps.accounts.models import User
from apps.reports.views import export_rows
from .models import Employee, EmergencyContact

class NextId(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,29);require_hr(request.user)
        last=Employee.all_objects.order_by('-pk').first()
        return Response({'employee_code':f'KN{(last.pk+1 if last else 1):03d}'})

class CheckEmail(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,29);require_hr(request.user)
        return Response({'exists':User.objects.filter(email__iexact=request.query_params.get('email','')).exists()})

class EmployeeExport(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,29);require_hr(request.user)
        rows=[{'Employee ID':e.employee_code,'Name':e.user.get_full_name(),'Email':e.user.email,'Joining date':str(e.date_of_joining),'Status':e.employee_status} for e in Employee.objects.select_related('user')]
        return export_rows(rows,'Employees','csv')

class EmergencyPDF(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request,employee_id):
        require_menu(request.user,29);require_hr(request.user)
        employee=get_object_or_404(Employee.objects,pk=employee_id)
        rows=list(EmergencyContact.objects.filter(user=employee.user).values('name','relationship','home_phone','mobile','email','address'))
        return export_rows(rows,'Emergency contacts','pdf')

class JobReporting(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def context(self,request,employee_id):
        employee=get_object_or_404(Employee.objects,pk=employee_id)
        if is_hr(request.user):require_menu(request.user,29)
        else:
            require_menu(request.user,71)
            if employee.user_id!=request.user.pk or request.method!='GET':raise PermissionDenied()
        return employee
    def get(self,request,employee_id,section):
        employee=self.context(request,employee_id)
        if section=='subordinates':return Response([{'id':e.user_id,'name':e.user.get_full_name()} for e in Employee.objects.filter(reports_to=employee.user).select_related('user')])
        if section=='supervisors':return Response({'reports_to':employee.reports_to_id})
        return Response({key:getattr(employee,key) for key in ['job_title_id','employment_type_id','date_of_joining','sub_unit_id','location']})
    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self,request,employee_id,section):
        employee=self.context(request,employee_id)
        if section=='supervisors':
            manager=get_object_or_404(User,pk=request.data.get('reports_to'),is_active=True,is_deleted=False)
            if manager.pk==employee.user_id:raise ValidationError({'reports_to':['An employee cannot report to themselves.']})
            # Walk the reporting chain to prevent cycles.
            seen={employee.user_id};current=manager
            while current:
                if current.pk in seen:raise ValidationError({'reports_to':['Reporting lines cannot contain a cycle.']})
                seen.add(current.pk);profile=Employee.objects.filter(user=current).first();current=profile.reports_to if profile else None
            employee.reports_to=manager
        else:
            allowed={'job_title','employment_type','date_of_joining','sub_unit','location'}
            if set(request.data)-allowed:raise ValidationError({'fields':['Unsupported job field.']})
            serializer=model_serializer(Employee,request.user)(employee,data=request.data,partial=True);serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
            for k,v in serializer.validated_data.items():setattr(employee,k,v)
        employee.save(actor=request.user)
        return self.get(request,employee_id,section)
    def patch(self,request,employee_id,section):return self.put(request,employee_id,section)
````

````python
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q, F
from django.db.models.functions import Lower
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.core.fields import EncryptedTextField
from apps.core.models import BaseModel

def default_working_days():
    return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]


class Employee(BaseModel):
    user = models.OneToOneField('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    employee_code = models.CharField(max_length=30)
    date_of_birth = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    date_of_joining = models.DateField()
    sub_unit = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    designation = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    nationality = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    reports_to = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    employment_type = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    employee_status = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Confirm Employees', 'Confirm Employees'), ('On Probation', 'On Probation'), ('On Notice Period', 'On Notice Period')], default='Confirm Employees')
    gender = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Male', 'Male'), ('Female', 'Female'), ('Other', 'Other')], default='Male')
    marital_status = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Single', 'Single'), ('Married', 'Married'), ('Other', 'Other')], default='Single')
    process = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    work_mode = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    job_title = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    working_capacity_pct = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=100)
    working_days = models.JSONField(default=default_working_days)
    weekly_work_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=40)
    address = EncryptedTextField(blank=True)
    location = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    driver_licence_number = EncryptedTextField(blank=True)
    licence_expiry = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    medical_condition = EncryptedTextField(blank=True)
    deactivated_on = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    photo = models.ForeignKey("core.PrivateFile", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    rms_applicant = models.ForeignKey('recruitment.Applicant', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['employee_code'], condition=Q(is_deleted=False), name='unique_employee_code'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(working_capacity_pct__gte=1, working_capacity_pct__lte=100), name='employee_capacity_range'),
        ]


class EmployeeDocument(BaseModel):
    user = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    document_list_item = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    number = EncryptedTextField(blank=True)
    issued_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    expiry_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    file = models.ForeignKey("core.PrivateFile", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    checked_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    is_archived = models.BooleanField(default=False)
````

## backend/apps/employees/views.py

````python
from django.apps import apps
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from apps.core.access import require_menu, is_hr, require_hr
from apps.core.api import model_serializer
from apps.core.registry import PROFILE
from apps.accounts.admin_api import UserSerializer
from apps.core.models import AuditEvent
from .models import Employee

class EmployeeCreate(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,29);require_hr(request.user)
        account=request.data.get('account',{}).copy()
        if request.user.role_id!=1 and int(account.get('role',4))!=4:raise PermissionDenied()
        account.setdefault('role',4)
        user_ser=UserSerializer(data=account,context={'request':request})
        user_ser.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        user=user_ser.save()
        data=request.data.get('profile',{}).copy()
        if not data.get('employee_code'):
            last=Employee.all_objects.order_by('-pk').first()
            data['employee_code']=f'KN{(last.pk+1 if last else 1):03d}'
        serializer=model_serializer(Employee,request.user)(data=data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        employee=Employee(user=user,**serializer.validated_data)
        employee.save(actor=request.user)
        AuditEvent.objects.create(actor=request.user,entity='accounts.user',entity_id=str(user.pk),action='create')
        return Response(model_serializer(Employee,request.user)(employee).data,status=201)

class OwnProfile(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,71)
        employee=get_object_or_404(Employee.objects,user=request.user)
        return Response(model_serializer(Employee,request.user)(employee).data)
    def patch(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,71)
        if set(request.data)-{'phone'}:raise PermissionDenied()
        request.user.phone=str(request.data.get('phone',''))[:40]
        request.user.save()
        AuditEvent.objects.create(actor=request.user,entity='accounts.user',entity_id=str(request.user.pk),action='update_contact')
        return Response({'phone':request.user.phone})

class ProfileSection(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def context(self,request,employee_id,section):
        employee=get_object_or_404(Employee.objects,pk=employee_id)
        if section not in PROFILE:raise ValidationError({'section':['Unknown profile section.']})
        if is_hr(request.user):require_menu(request.user,29)
        else:
            require_menu(request.user,71)
            if employee.user_id!=request.user.pk:raise PermissionDenied()
            if section=='salary':raise PermissionDenied()
            if request.method!='GET' and section not in ['addresses','contact-details','emergency-contacts','documents']:raise PermissionDenied()
        return employee,apps.get_model('employees',PROFILE[section])
    def get(self,request,employee_id,section,pk=None):
        employee,model=self.context(request,employee_id,section)
        rows=model.objects.filter(user=employee.user).order_by('-pk')
        serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)
        if pk:return Response(serializer(get_object_or_404(rows,pk=pk)).data)
        return Response({'count':rows.count(),'next':None,'previous':None,'results':serializer(rows,many=True).data})
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self,request,employee_id,section,pk=None):
        employee,model=self.context(request,employee_id,section)
        data=request.data.copy();data['user']=employee.user_id
        serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)(data=data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        values=dict(serializer.validated_data);values['user']=employee.user
        if not is_hr(request.user):values.pop('verified',None);values.pop('checked_date',None)
        row=model(**values);row.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response(model_serializer(model,request.user)(row).data,status=201)
    @transaction.atomic
    def patch(self,request,employee_id,section,pk):
        employee,model=self.context(request,employee_id,section)
        row=get_object_or_404(model.objects,user=employee.user,pk=pk)
        serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)(row,data=request.data,partial=True)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        for key,value in serializer.validated_data.items():
            if key!='user':setattr(row,key,value)
        row.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response(model_serializer(model,request.user)(row).data)
    def delete(self,request,employee_id,section,pk):
        employee,model=self.context(request,employee_id,section)
        row=get_object_or_404(model.objects,user=employee.user,pk=pk)
        row.delete(actor=request.user)
        return Response(status=204)

class VerifyDocument(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def post(self,request,employee_id,pk):
        from django.utils import timezone
        from .models import EmployeeDocument
        require_menu(request.user,29);require_hr(request.user)
        employee=get_object_or_404(Employee.objects,pk=employee_id)
        document=get_object_or_404(EmployeeDocument.objects,pk=pk,user=employee.user)
        document.verified=True;document.checked_date=timezone.localdate();document.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response({'message':'Document verified.'})

class Directory(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request):
        require_menu(request.user,58)
        rows=Employee.objects.filter(status=True).select_related('user','job_title','sub_unit')
        return Response({'count':rows.count(),'next':None,'previous':None,'results':[{'id':e.pk,'name':e.user.get_full_name(),'job_title':e.job_title.name if e.job_title else '', 'sub_unit':e.sub_unit.name if e.sub_unit else '', 'photo':e.photo_id} for e in rows]})
````

````python
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q, F
from django.db.models.functions import Lower
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.core.fields import EncryptedTextField
from apps.core.models import BaseModel


class LeaveYear(BaseModel):
    from_date = models.DateField()
    to_date = models.DateField()
    process = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    is_default = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(from_date__lt=F("to_date")), name='leave_year_dates'),
        ]


class LeaveType(BaseModel):
    leave_year = models.ForeignKey('leave.LeaveYear', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    allocation_per_year = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    process = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['leave_year', 'name'], condition=Q(is_deleted=False), name='unique_leave_type'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(allocation_per_year__gte=0), name='leave_allocation_positive'),
        ]


class LeaveEntitlement(BaseModel):
    user = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    leave_type = models.ForeignKey('leave.LeaveType', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    assigned = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
````

## backend/apps/pmo/views.py

````python
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from apps.core.access import require_menu, is_hr
from apps.core.api import model_serializer
from .models import Query, QueryReply

class QueryReplies(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def context(self,request,pk):
        require_menu(request.user,79)
        query=get_object_or_404(Query.objects,pk=pk)
        if query.employee_id!=request.user.pk and not is_hr(request.user):raise PermissionDenied()
        return query
    def get(self,request,pk):
        query=self.context(request,pk)
        return Response(model_serializer(QueryReply,request.user)(QueryReply.objects.filter(query=query).order_by('created_at'),many=True).data)
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self,request,pk):
        query=self.context(request,pk)
        if query.status=='Closed':raise ValidationError({'message':['This query is closed.']})
        import bleach
        message=bleach.clean(str(request.data.get('message','')),tags=['p','strong','em','ul','ol','li','br'],strip=True)
        if not message.strip():raise ValidationError({'message':['Please enter message.']})
        reply=QueryReply(query=query,author=request.user,message=message)
        reply.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response(model_serializer(QueryReply,request.user)(reply).data,status=201)
````

## backend/apps/projects/models.py

````python
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q, F
from django.db.models.functions import Lower
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.core.fields import EncryptedTextField
from apps.core.models import BaseModel


class Project(BaseModel):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    client = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    start_date = models.DateField()
    end_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    lead = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    members = models.ManyToManyField('accounts.User', blank=True, related_name="+")
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(end_date__isnull=True)|Q(end_date__gte=F("start_date")), name='project_dates'),
        ]


class ProjectDocument(BaseModel):
    project = models.ForeignKey('projects.Project', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    file = models.ForeignKey("core.PrivateFile", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")


class Task(BaseModel):
    project = models.ForeignKey('projects.Project', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('High', 'High'), ('Medium', 'Medium'), ('Low', 'Low')], default='High')
    assignees = models.ManyToManyField('accounts.User', blank=True, related_name="+")
    deadline = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('To Do', 'To Do'), ('Not Started', 'Not Started'), ('In progress', 'In progress'), ('Testing', 'Testing'), ('On Hold', 'On Hold'), ('Review', 'Review'), ('Completed', 'Completed')], default='To Do')
    total_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    estimated_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    remaining_hours = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    start_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    end_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)


class TaskComment(BaseModel):
    task = models.ForeignKey('projects.Task', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    author = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    message = models.TextField(blank=True)
    attachment = models.ForeignKey("core.PrivateFile", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
````

````python
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q, F
from django.db.models.functions import Lower
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.core.fields import EncryptedTextField
from apps.core.models import BaseModel


class JobRole(BaseModel):
    reference_no = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    positions = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=1)
    publish_date = models.DateField()
    expiry_date = models.DateField()
    portal1_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    portal1_reference = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    portal2_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    portal2_reference = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    portal3_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    portal3_reference = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    salary_min_gbp = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    salary_max_gbp = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Open', 'Open'), ('Paused', 'Paused'), ('Closed', 'Closed')], default='Open')
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['reference_no'], condition=Q(is_deleted=False), name='unique_job_reference'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(salary_max_gbp__gte=F("salary_min_gbp")), name='salary_range'),
        ]


class Applicant(BaseModel):
    job_role = models.ForeignKey('recruitment.JobRole', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    email = models.EmailField()
    phone = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    cv_file = models.ForeignKey("core.PrivateFile", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    cv_text = models.TextField(blank=True)
    application_date = models.DateField()
    respond_to_portal = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    work_authorization = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    cv_evaluation_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    technical_test_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    final_interview_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    cif_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    job_offered_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    joining_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    cv_evaluation_status = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    technical_test_status = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    final_interview_status = models.ForeignKey('masters.MasterItem', on_delete=models.PROTECT, null=True, blank=True, related_name="+")
    application_pack_location = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    applicant_status = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Awaiting', 'Awaiting'), ('Selected', 'Selected'), ('Joined', 'Joined'), ('Rejected', 'Rejected')], default='Awaiting')


class CvEvaluation(BaseModel):
    applicant = models.ForeignKey('recruitment.Applicant', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    assessor_name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    assessment_date = models.DateField()
    ratings = models.JSONField(default=list)
    outcome = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Strong', 'Strong'), ('Potential', 'Potential'), ('Rejected', 'Rejected')], default='Strong')
    note = models.TextField(blank=True)
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['applicant'], condition=Q(is_deleted=False), name='unique_cv_evaluation'),
        ]


class TechnicalQuestion(BaseModel):
    job_roles = models.ManyToManyField('recruitment.JobRole', blank=True, related_name="+")
    type = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('MCQ', 'MCQ'), ('Brief', 'Brief')], default='MCQ')
    question = models.TextField(blank=True)
    option_a = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True)
    option_b = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True)

    option_d = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True)
    correct_answer = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True)
    code_snippet = models.TextField(blank=True)
    answer_explanation = models.TextField(blank=True)
    video_link = models.CharField(max_length=500, blank=True)

class InterviewQuestion(BaseModel):
    job_roles = models.ManyToManyField('recruitment.JobRole', blank=True, related_name="+")
    type = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Panel 1', 'Panel 1'), ('Panel 2', 'Panel 2'), ('Panel 3', 'Panel 3')], default='Panel 1')
    question = models.TextField(blank=True)


class InterviewNote(BaseModel):
    applicant = models.ForeignKey('recruitment.Applicant', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    panel = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=1)
    interviewer = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")

        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [

        ]


class ApplicantDocument(BaseModel):
    applicant = models.ForeignKey('recruitment.Applicant', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)

class CandidateInvitation(BaseModel):
    applicant = models.ForeignKey('recruitment.Applicant', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('test', 'test'), ('cif', 'cif'), ('reference', 'reference')], default='test')
    digest = models.CharField(max_length=64)

        ]
````

## backend/apps/recruitment/views.py

````python
import hashlib
import json
import secrets
from datetime import timedelta
from django.conf import settings
from django.core.mail import send_mail
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.decorators import method_decorator
from django.views.decorators.csrf import csrf_protect
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated, AllowAny
from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError, PermissionDenied
from rest_framework.response import Response
from apps.core.access import require_menu
from apps.core.api import model_serializer
from .models import Applicant, CandidateInvitation, TechnicalQuestion, CvEvaluation, InterviewNote, ApplicantDocument

class CandidateSend(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self,request,pk,kind):
        require_menu(request.user,47)
        applicant=get_object_or_404(Applicant.objects,pk=pk)
        if kind not in ['test','cif','reference']:raise ValidationError({'kind':['Invalid invitation type.']})
        questions={}
        if kind=='test':
            available=list(TechnicalQuestion.objects.filter(status=True,job_roles=applicant.job_role))
            if len(available)<20:raise ValidationError({'questions':['Configure at least 20 active questions for this role.']})
            selected=secrets.SystemRandom().sample(available,20)
            questions={'items':[{'id':q.pk,'type':q.type,'question':q.question,'options':[q.option_a,q.option_b,q.option_c,q.option_d],'answer':q.correct_answer} for q in selected]}
        token=secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
        invite=CandidateInvitation(applicant=applicant,kind=kind,digest=hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),expires_at=timezone.now()+timedelta(days=7),questions=questions)
        invite.save(actor=request.user)
        link=f'{settings.FRONTEND_ORIGIN}/{kind}/{token}'
        send_mail('HRDESK candidate invitation',f'Please complete your {kind}: {link}\nThis link expires in seven days.',settings.DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL,[applicant.email])
        return Response({'message':'Invitation sent.','expires_at':invite.expires_at})

@method_decorator(csrf_protect,name='dispatch')
class PublicCandidate(APIView):
    permission_classes=[AllowAny]
    authentication_classes=[]
    def invitation(self,token):
        row=CandidateInvitation.objects.filter(digest=hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),consumed_at=None).first()
        if not row:raise ValidationError({'token':['This link has expired or has already been used.']})
        return row
    def get(self,request,token):
        row=self.invitation(token)
        questions=[{k:v for k,v in q.items() if k!='answer'} for q in row.questions.get('items',[])]
        return Response({'kind':row.kind,'questions':questions})
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self,request,token):
        row=self.invitation(token)
        if row.kind=='test':
            answers=request.data.get('answers')
            ids={str(q['id']) for q in row.questions['items']}
            if not isinstance(answers,dict) or set(answers)!=ids:raise ValidationError({'answers':['Please answer all 20 questions.']})
        else:
            answers=request.data.get('answers')
            if not isinstance(answers,dict) or not answers:raise ValidationError({'answers':['Please complete the form.']})
        if len(json.dumps(answers))>100000:raise ValidationError({'answers':['Submission is too large.']})
        row.answers=json.dumps(answers);row.consumed_at=timezone.now();row.save()
        return Response({'message':'Thank you. Your response has been submitted.'})

class Evaluation(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request,pk):
        require_menu(request.user,47)
        applicant=get_object_or_404(Applicant.objects,pk=pk)
        row=CvEvaluation.objects.filter(applicant=applicant).first()
        return Response(model_serializer(CvEvaluation,request.user)(row).data if row else {})
    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self,request,pk):
        require_menu(request.user,47)
        applicant=get_object_or_404(Applicant.objects,pk=pk)
        data=request.data.copy();data['applicant']=applicant.pk
        ratings=data.get('ratings')
        if not isinstance(ratings,list) or len(ratings)!=8 or any(not isinstance(r,dict) or type(r.get('rating')) is not int or not 1<=r['rating']<=5 for r in ratings):raise ValidationError({'ratings':['Provide eight ratings, each between 1 and 5, with comments.']})
        row=CvEvaluation.objects.filter(applicant=applicant).first()
        serializer=model_serializer(CvEvaluation,request.user)(row,data=data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        row=row or CvEvaluation(applicant=applicant)
        for k,v in serializer.validated_data.items():setattr(row,k,v)
        row.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response(model_serializer(CvEvaluation,request.user)(row).data)

class ParseCV(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def post(self,request,pk):
        from pathlib import Path
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        import zipfile
        from xml.etree import ElementTree
        require_menu(request.user,47)
        applicant=get_object_or_404(Applicant.objects,pk=pk)
        if not applicant.cv_file:raise ValidationError({'cv_file':['Upload a CV first.']})
        path=Path(settings.MEDIA_ROOT)/applicant.cv_file.stored_name
        if path.suffix.lower()=='.pdf':
            try:text='\n'.join(page.extract_text() or '' for page in PdfReader(path).pages)
            except Exception:raise ValidationError({'cv_file':['Unable to extract this PDF.']})
        elif path.suffix.lower()=='.docx':
            try:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:root=ElementTree.fromstring(z.read('word/document.xml'))
                text=' '.join(root.itertext())
            except Exception:raise ValidationError({'cv_file':['Unable to extract this DOCX file.']})
        else:raise ValidationError({'cv_file':['Local CV text extraction supports PDF and DOCX. Configure an external parser for other formats.']})
        applicant.cv_text=text[:200000];applicant.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response({'cv_text':applicant.cv_text,'message':'CV text extracted. Review before use.'})

class ApplicantSection(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request,pk,section,panel=None):
        require_menu(request.user,47)
        applicant=get_object_or_404(Applicant.objects,pk=pk)
        if section=='documents':return Response(model_serializer(ApplicantDocument,request.user)(ApplicantDocument.objects.filter(applicant=applicant),many=True).data)
        row=InterviewNote.objects.filter(applicant=applicant,panel=panel).first()
        return Response(model_serializer(InterviewNote,request.user)(row).data if row else {})
    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self,request,pk,section,panel=None):
        require_menu(request.user,47)
        applicant=get_object_or_404(Applicant.objects,pk=pk)
        data=request.data.copy();data['applicant']=applicant.pk
        model=ApplicantDocument if section=='documents' else InterviewNote
        if model==InterviewNote:
            if panel not in [1,2,3]:raise ValidationError({'panel':['Choose panel 1, 2 or 3.']})
            data.update(panel=panel,interviewer=request.user.pk)
        row=InterviewNote.objects.filter(applicant=applicant,panel=panel).first() if model==InterviewNote else None
        serializer=model_serializer(model,request.user)(row,data=data);serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        row=row or model()
        for key,value in serializer.validated_data.items():setattr(row,key,value)
        row.save(actor=request.user)
        return Response(model_serializer(model,request.user)(row).data,status=201)
    def put(self,request,pk,section,panel=None):return self.post(request,pk,section,panel)
````

````python
import csv
import io
from html import escape
from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError
from apps.core.access import require_menu, require_hr
from apps.core.services import leave_usage


def export_rows(rows,title,kind):
    columns=list(rows[0]) if rows else ['message']
    if kind=='csv':
        stream=io.StringIO();writer=csv.writer(stream);writer.writerow(columns)
        for row in rows:
            values=[]
            for key in columns:
                value=str(row.get(key,''))
                if value.startswith(('=','+','-','@','\t','\r')):value="'"+value
                values.append(value)
            writer.writerow(values)
        response=HttpResponse('\ufeff'+stream.getvalue(),content_type='text/csv; charset=utf-8')
    elif kind=='pdf':
        from xhtml2pdf import pisa
        html='<html><head><style>@page {size: A4 landscape; margin: 1cm} body {font-family: Helvetica; font-size:9pt} td,th {padding:4pt;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc}</style></head><body><h1>'+escape(title)+'</h1><table><tr>'+''.join('<th>'+escape(c)+'</th>' for c in columns)+'</tr>'
        html+=''.join('<tr>'+''.join('<td>'+escape(str(row.get(c,'')))+'</td>' for c in columns)+'</tr>' for row in rows)+'</table></body></html>'
        stream=io.BytesIO();result=pisa.CreatePDF(html,dest=stream)
        if result.err:raise ValidationError({'export':['Unable to render PDF.']})
        response=HttpResponse(stream.getvalue(),content_type='application/pdf')
    else:raise ValidationError({'format':['Choose csv or pdf.']})
    response['Content-Disposition']=f'attachment; filename="{title.lower().replace(" ","-")}.{kind}"'
    response['Cache-Control']='no-store'
    return response

class Report(APIView):
    permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated]
    def get(self,request,kind):
        code={'leave':42,'attendance':68,'pmo':85}.get(kind)
        if not code:raise ValidationError({'report':['Unknown report.']})
        require_menu(request.user,code);require_hr(request.user)
        rows=[]
        if kind=='leave':
            from apps.leave.models import LeaveEntitlement
            entries=LeaveEntitlement.objects.select_related('user','leave_type')
            if request.query_params.get('leave_year'):entries=entries.filter(leave_type__leave_year_id=request.query_params['leave_year'])
            for e in entries:rows.append({'Employee':e.user.get_full_name(),'Leave type':e.leave_type.name,**leave_usage(e.user,e.leave_type)})
        elif kind=='attendance':
            from apps.attendance.models import AttendanceSession
            entries=AttendanceSession.objects.select_related('user')
            for key in ['month','year']:
                if request.query_params.get(key):entries=entries.filter(**{'date__'+key:request.query_params[key]})
            if request.query_params.get('employee'):entries=entries.filter(user_id=request.query_params['employee'])
            rows=[{'Employee':e.user.get_full_name(),'Date':e.date.strftime('%d-%m-%Y'),'Punch in':e.punch_in.isoformat(),'Punch out':e.punch_out.isoformat() if e.punch_out else '', 'Hours':round(e.total_minutes/60,2)} for e in entries]
        else:
            from apps.pmo.models import WeeklyStatusReport
            entries=WeeklyStatusReport.objects.select_related('user')
            for key in ['month','year']:
                if request.query_params.get(key):entries=entries.filter(**{'week_start__'+key:request.query_params[key]})
            rows=[{'Employee':e.user.get_full_name(),'Week':e.week_start.strftime('%d-%m-%Y'),'Status':e.status} for e in entries]
        if request.query_params.get('export'):return export_rows(rows,kind+' report',request.query_params['export'])
        return Response({'count':len(rows),'next':None,'previous':None,'results':rows})
````

````python
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q, F
from django.db.models.functions import Lower
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.core.fields import EncryptedTextField
from apps.core.models import BaseModel


class Timesheet(BaseModel):
    user = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    start_date = models.DateField()
    end_date = models.DateField()
    approval_status = models.CharField(max_length=60, choices=[('Pending', 'Pending'), ('Accepted', 'Accepted'), ('Rejected', 'Rejected')], default='Pending')
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['user', 'start_date'], condition=Q(is_deleted=False), name='unique_timesheet_week'),
        ]


class TimesheetLine(BaseModel):
    timesheet = models.ForeignKey("timesheets.Timesheet", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="lines")
    project = models.ForeignKey('projects.Project', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    activity = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    day1 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    day2 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    day3 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    day4 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    day5 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    day6 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    day7 = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    class Meta(BaseModel.Meta):
        constraints = BaseModel.Meta.constraints + [
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day1__gte=0, day1__lte=10), name='timesheet_day1_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day2__gte=0, day2__lte=10), name='timesheet_day2_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day3__gte=0, day3__lte=10), name='timesheet_day3_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day4__gte=0, day4__lte=10), name='timesheet_day4_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day5__gte=0, day5__lte=10), name='timesheet_day5_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day6__gte=0, day6__lte=10), name='timesheet_day6_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(day7__gte=0, day7__lte=10), name='timesheet_day7_range'),
        ]


class TimesheetLog(BaseModel):
    timesheet = models.ForeignKey('timesheets.Timesheet', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    action = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    comment = models.TextField(blank=True)
    actor = models.ForeignKey('accounts.User', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
````
